suggested_fix: No security fix needed. The function checks whether the highmem page allocation failed before it uses or frees the pages, so it does not call __free_pages on a NULL pointer. Both test->buffer and test are freed on every path, and kfree(NULL) is safe. As a robustness improvement, the function could return -ENOMEM instead of count when the test->buffer allocation fails, so the caller learns that the test did not run.
